audit_notes: Model: steady water penetration with first-order hydrolysis in the erodible layer, c'' = phi^2 c with Thiele modulus phi = L*sqrt(k/D), c(0)=1 at the seawater side, zero flux at the primer. With the proposed D = 1e-12 m^2/s and k = 1e-6 1/s, phi = 3e-4*sqrt(1e6) = 0.3: water saturates the whole layer (mean c = tanh(phi)/phi = 0.97), i.e. BULK hydrolysis with a half-life of ln2/k = 8 days. The 300 um reservoir would lose its integrity within weeks, not 5 years; this contradicts the concept. Adjustment: a surface-eroding binder needs phi >> 1. I set D = 1e-14 m^2/s (hydrophobic, e.g. fluorinated or highly crosslinked polyester binder) and k = 1e-4 1/s (fast silyl-ester hydrolysis where water is present), giving a penetration depth sqrt(D/k) = 10 um (typical leached-layer thickness of self-polishing paints) and phi = 30, mean c = 0.033. Consistency check against the target erosion: a reaction-diffusion front alone erodes at about sqrt(D k) = 1e-9 m/s (2.6 mm/month), three orders of magnitude faster than the 1.9e-12 m/s target; in real self-polishing paints the rate is set by ion exchange and by the removal of the hydrolysed, still-attached layer by flow shear, which this model does not contain. So the erosion rate is not predicted by this model; the simulation only shows whether hydrolysis is surface-confined (metric: mean water/hydrolysis fraction through the layer, lower = more surface-confined and more durable). No conventional baseline exists for this metric: a silicone foul-release coating does not hydrolyse at all, so baseline_parameters are left empty and the gain is not available. Stress check: hydrolysed leached layer is mechanically weak; loss of cohesion in the leached layer is the intended erosion. Main concern stays: biocide-free erosion of a few um per month does not remove settled cyprids and tubeworm larvae (anchored within hours), and the polymer fragments released (tens of g/m^2 over 5 years, about 300 um * 1200 kg/m^3 = 0.36 kg/m^2) are persistent unless the binder is truly biodegradable. Dimensionless: Thiele modulus 30 (adjusted), penetration depth ratio 0.033. Simulation coefficient: penetration depth 1e-5 m (informational).
